beats.say: The FTC says a disclosure in your bio isn't enough. Here's how to disclose a link the right way.
Put it in the post itself, where it's hard to miss.

show.headline: Disclose *in the post*, where it's hard to miss

beats.say: Not only in your bio, at the very end, or behind a more button.
In a video, say it and show it on screen, because some people watch without sound.

show.text: In a video: *say it* and *show it*

beats.say: Use clear words like ad or sponsored. Skip sp, spon and collab, and don't rely on the platform's tool alone. Posting from outside the US? US rules can still apply.
Save this before your next link, and follow for one income stream every day.

show.text: Save this. General info, *not legal advice*

sources.title: FTC: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
